records.name: Rocco Ruckordnung
records.biography_en: He makes room for others by becoming extremely difficult to move. He anchors the residents' scrum and sorts demands into movable or certainly not. His bandaged hands are gentler than the building's instructions. A dissonant card has suggested that making space need not always involve making a point. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er gibt nicht nach. Eine Ausnahme wurde zum Anlehnen vorgesehen.

variant_notes.note_en: He makes room for others by becoming extremely difficult to move.

records.name: Hilda Hakenschluss
records.biography_en: She holds the pack together with affection that sounds like an order. She binds the corridor team together with an oval ball and the tone of a loving ultimatum. The association recognises unity or disobedience. She is slowly learning that a neighbour can belong without moving on command. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Zusammenhalt ist angeordnet. Sie meint es allerdings freundlich.

variant_notes.note_en: She holds the pack together with affection that sounds like an order.

records.name: Leo Langverband
records.biography_en: He is useful at great heights and uncertain at conversational ones. He carries a support strap because the league values residents chiefly by how high they can lift its expectations. His categories are useful or in the way. A dissonant card asks who supports the supporter; he has kept it. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er wird gebraucht. Über seine eigene Stütze wird später beraten.

variant_notes.note_en: He is useful at great heights and uncertain at conversational ones.

records.name: Fina Fadenzieher
records.biography_en: She starts every movement and denies responsibility for where it ends. She starts the courtyard's passing movements and considers every delayed answer obstruction. The oval ball gives her something real to hand over. She has begun leaving a gap for a neighbour who needs more time to decide. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Sie eröffnet das Spiel. Für den Verlauf war jemand anders vorgesehen.

variant_notes.note_en: She starts every movement and denies responsibility for where it ends.

records.name: Felix Feldplan
records.biography_en: He can read the game until somebody actually begins playing it. His cloth diagram offers three reassuring arcs and no explanation of what the opponents might do. HyperNorm requires plans to be either certain or unofficial. He now draws space for other people without claiming to know their next move. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Plan berücksichtigt alles. Ausgenommen Beteiligte.

variant_notes.note_en: He can read the game until somebody actually begins playing it.

records.name: Benny Durchbruch
records.biography_en: He mistakes a narrow gap for a personal invitation. He carries the ball through gaps the building insists are closed. The official distinction is breakthrough or breach. A contradictory card has made him save some of his enthusiasm for helping a hesitant neighbour through afterwards. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er sah eine Lücke. Sie wurde nachträglich als Zugang anerkannt.

variant_notes.note_en: He mistakes a narrow gap for a personal invitation.
